ice.name: Ice
ice.note: Frozen water. Split it for oxygen.

iron_ore.name: Iron ore
iron_ore.note: Rust-red rock rich in iron oxide (Fe₂O₃).

silica.name: Silica
silica.note: Sandstone grains (SiO₂). Glass and solar cells start here.

carbon.name: Carbon
carbon.note: Black seams of ancient plant matter.

iron_plate.name: Iron plate
iron_plate.note: Smelted iron. Carbon pulls the oxygen out of the ore (and leaves smoke).

silicon.name: Silicon
silicon.note: Pure silicon, baked out of silica with carbon. The heart of solar cells and chips.

o2_canister.name: O₂ canister
o2_canister.note: Press Q to breathe it: +40% oxygen.

hydrogen.name: Hydrogen
hydrogen.note: Left over when the electrolyzer splits water. A Sabatier reactor turns it into fuel.

methane.name: Methane
methane.note: Fuel made from CO₂ and hydrogen. Rockets will need it.

bloom.name: Bloom
bloom.note: A rare glowing flower that only grows where the air, water and soil are clean.

conveyor.name: Conveyor
conveyor.note: Belt sections, 2 m each. Press C to lay a belt from one machine to another.

electrolyzer.name: Electrolyzer
electrolyzer.note: Splits ice into oxygen and hydrogen. Feeds your shelter.

battery.name: Battery
battery.note: Stores solar power for the night.

solar_lotus.name: Solar lotus
solar_lotus.note: Turns sunlight into power. Useless at night.

smelter.name: Smelter
smelter.note: Turns iron ore and carbon into iron plates. Needs 3 kW. Smokes.

research_station.name: Research station
research_station.note: Works out new machines from the parts you give it.

auto_drill.name: Auto-drill
auto_drill.note: Mines whatever lies under it, forever. Place it over rich ground.

storage_silo.name: Storage silo
storage_silo.note: Holds 300 items. Belts can fill it and empty it.

power_pylon.name: Power pylon
power_pylon.note: Carries power 14 m further. Pylons link to each other up to 26 m apart.

coal_burner.name: Coal burner
coal_burner.note: Burns carbon for 5 kW, day and night. Smoky.

silicon_furnace.name: Silicon furnace
silicon_furnace.note: Bakes silica with carbon into silicon. Needs 3 kW.

bio_filter.name: Bio-filter
bio_filter.note: Algae clean the air while it has power.

settling_pond.name: Settling pond
settling_pond.note: Lets mud and grit sink out of dirty water. Cleans water and soil, needs no power.

sabatier_reactor.name: Sabatier reactor
sabatier_reactor.note: Turns CO₂ from the air and hydrogen into methane fuel and water.
